authority.body_identity: artifact authority release ID plus exact 3MF object metadata and ordered BGCODE M486 identity; filename and plate position alone are not authority
authority.scope: current twelve-plate MK4 / Elegoo PLA C2 manufacturing package

supersession.prior_scope: retained legacy eight-plate MK4 / Elegoo PLA package
supersession.reason: C2 geometry/profile/failure-domain repack; old hashes and plate mappings must not be used with this package

decoder_evidence.binding: Every decoded-gcode SHA256 and ordered M486 object list is paired with the current plate BGCODE SHA256.

policy.print_now_test_article: May print only as a measured test article; does not authorize assembly or operating use.
policy.coupon_first: Print a bounded interface/material coupon or single first article before queuing the body.
policy.hold: Do not queue from the current package until the stated blocker is reworked or evidenced.
policy.support_rule: Any decoded support on a body with unresolved mating, sealing, snap, datum, or deck surfaces is a blocker until contact location and cleanup allowance are proved.
policy.mixed_plate_rule: A multi-body plate inherits the strictest contained-body disposition.
